title_o: Observer-rated outcomes of communication-centered treatment for adults who stutter: A social validation study

replications.quote: Untrained observers confirmed that participation in this strengths-based approach significantly enhances communication competence.
These findings replicate ratings from untrained observers in Byrd et al. (6, N = 81 raters, N = 1 adult who stutters) on a larger scale (N = 1,110 raters, N = 10 adults who stutter).
